$Comment: The binding row for the game's own Feastmaster fight, the boss of the goblin Deepworks
(Dungeon_Feastmaster_Encounter). The script shows a boss bar, so the library already runs and
credits the fight without a row; this row only names it and keeps its records (wins, fastest
win, best share, damage) on Records' Boss Fights under the bucket dungeon_feastmaster.
Subject.TargetSlot names the script's own slot for the boss (Feastmaster), so the library binds
the boss it credits; a row left at the default Boss would bind nothing. Beyond that it writes
nothing on purpose: no Scale, Loot, Timing, Feedback or Discovery, so the fight runs exactly as
the game authored it, under the library's defaults (no extra health, no pay, no map marker, no
rest). Add a group here to change one of those for your server. Switch the row off with Enabled
false, or from mods/ziggfreedcommon/encounters.json under the key dungeon_feastmaster_encounter,
and the fight keeps no records.
